description: AASHTOWare Bridge Management is AASHTO's asset management system for highway bridges, part of the AASHTOWare Bridge suite, which also includes Bridge Design, Bridge Rating and linked third-party tools sharing a single database. It stores bridge inventory and inspection data, formulates network-wide preservation and improvement plans to evaluate the needs of each bridge, and recommends projects to include in an agency's programme. Coverage: generic for transportation agencies; it supports the whole bridge management cycle, maintenance tracking and federal reporting, and weighs public safety and risk reduction, user convenience and preservation of investment. Format and access: installed software with a graphical interface and a bundled Crystal Reports developer licence, or a SaaS version. Licence and cost: an agency licence permits use on unlimited workstations in a single-tenant environment within the agency and by its agents on structures it manages. Caveats: deterioration and cost models need agency data and calibration. It supports optimisation of bridge maintenance programmes and resilience planning for bridge networks. It relates to the National Bridge Inventory in the catalogue.
